# @yesid/motion

Consumer-neutral motion mechanics: Svelte actions, reduced-motion state, motion policy,
GSAP/Lenis helpers, generated token projections, and optional CSS. Products own page choreography,
scroll narratives, persisted state, and art direction.

## Interface

The root and `./actions` exports provide shared actions. Policy, generated tokens, reduced-motion,
device, ticker, GSAP, Lenis, ripple, and section-magnet surfaces are available through explicit
subpaths. See [`api-reports/motion.api.md`](https://github.com/mgkdante/yesid.dev-design/blob/v0.27.0/api-reports/motion.api.md) for the exact public
interface.

## Invariants

- Safe-always feedback and motion-gated effects follow `policy.ts`; reduced motion does not mean
  disabling every response.
- Browser access and listeners are guarded and cleaned up by the owning action or helper.
- Consumers import optional CSS explicitly. The package installs no global CSS or app conditional.
- `magnetic`, `boop`, and `cursorGlow` read duration/easing/color variables supplied by
  `@yesid/tokens/tokens.css` at runtime.
- `src/tokens.ts` is generated by the root token build and is never hand-edited.
- `morphHover` and product scroll scrubs remain consumer-owned.

## GSAP and route transitions

`./utils/gsap` registers ScrollTrigger (`initScrollTriggerConfig`) and SplitText eagerly.
`loadDrawSVG`, `loadMorphSVG` and `loadCustomEase` import and register their plugin on first
call, so an app that never calls one doesn't bundle it.

`./utils/viewTransition` exports `viewTransition` for SvelteKit's `onNavigate`. It crossfades
client navigations with the View Transitions API and skips same-path navigations, browsers
without the API and reduced motion. The crossfade CSS lives in `@yesid/ui/base.css`.

## Blueprint scrub

`./utils/blueprintScrub` exports `blueprintScrub(band, trigger = band)`: it draws the blueprint art in
`band` (`.blueprint-bg svg path`) as `trigger` scrolls through the viewport, counting scrolls of
inner scrollers too, redraws when `trigger` resizes, and returns its cleanup. It does nothing under reduced motion or at 1023px
and below, where the art stays fully drawn. `ListingFrame`'s `onHeaderMount={blueprintScrub}`
passes the header and the frame.

## Smooth scroll

`initLenis()` starts Lenis on the window, driven by the GSAP ticker and bridged to ScrollTrigger.
It does nothing under reduced motion or on touch devices. `initLenis({ wrapper, content })`
scrolls an element instead; `content` must wrap the whole scrolling flow so Lenis tracks its
height. `getLenis()` returns the instance for app-owned navigation and lock handling.

Apply `scrollChain` to every nested scroller inside a Lenis page. It scrolls the element until an
edge, then hands the wheel to the page, and stops any page glide in flight when the element takes
the wheel back. Elements that own wheel and pinch input, such as maps, use Lenis's built-in
`data-lenis-prevent` attribute instead.

`@yesid/motion/lenis.css` is the Lenis stylesheet, copied so isolated installs can import it.
`@yesid/ui/base.css` imports it, so an app that imports base.css needs nothing else and drops any
direct `lenis/dist/lenis.css` import.

GSAP remains third-party software under its own terms; it is not covered by this repository's MIT
grant. See [`NOTICE`](https://github.com/mgkdante/yesid.dev-design/blob/v0.27.0/NOTICE) for the exact licence boundary.

## Consumers and compatibility

Gallery exercises shared motion and optional global ripple behavior. `@yesid/ui` consumes
`pressBounce`. External products pin immutable releases and keep page choreography local. Current
receipts live in [`CONSUMERS.md`](https://github.com/mgkdante/yesid.dev-design/blob/v0.27.0/CONSUMERS.md).

## Commands

```sh
bun run --cwd packages/motion test
bun run --cwd packages/motion check
bun run ci:tokens
```

## Failure modes and release implications

Missing browser guards, listener cleanup, reduced-motion gating, token CSS, or GSAP registration
fails package or Gallery coverage. Diagnose the smallest owning action/helper before changing a
consumer.

Implementation, CSS, generated-token, public-interface, or README changes alter the coordinated
release payload. Follow [`RELEASING.md`](https://github.com/mgkdante/yesid.dev-design/blob/v0.27.0/RELEASING.md); regenerate the API report only when
the public interface changes. Product conflicts are demoted, never encoded as app switches; see
[`BOUNDARIES.md`](https://github.com/mgkdante/yesid.dev-design/blob/v0.27.0/BOUNDARIES.md).
